text: B0 topology amendment accepted at board posts post-01M19GAWWWPH3FHBRG4RM91815 and post-01M19GG27AXM2YA9A8DE9RR095. B0-A closure requires a reviewed disposition for every named owner-action leaf; silence/absence is not a disposition. Optional NotSelectedForCurrentVertical or ExcludedUntilSelected accounts for scope without admission or dependency; SelectedPendingDecision, Unknown, and Blocked do not close. Required source is a separate Sherlock-or-actually-ratified-replacement bead. Aggregate B0 depends on A/B/C/D; C1 depends on B0 and P1 separately; no B0 edge to C1, D0, or the entire optional registry. Chief must instantiate; this note grants no source, terms, dependency, or implementation authority.
